input: bts.lithography.latent-dose.v1; full circular optical wafer; local ROI

grid.order: row-major; unchanged origin and spacing from input

openPolygons: closed non-overlapping per-row cell-run polygons, coordinates mm in input frame; no subpixel interpolation
source: all input metadata except grid; preserves mask/contact IDs
scope: local ROI only; missing outside ROI is unknown, not zero

metrics.doseToClear_mJ_cm2: finite positive-tone clearing dose at entered time, or null if not applicable or no finite dose
